notes.title: Meet me at NooN is now "very positive"
notes.content:
Exciting news, time travelers ! Meet me at NooN just achieved a nice "Very Positive" review status on Steam with an incredible 100% positive rating. 🌟

We can't thank our players enough for their love and support and we're beaming with pride because of your amazing feedback.

Thank you and have fun !

notes.title: Meet me at NooN won a Tencent's GWB Award
notes.content:
Hello fellow time travellers ! 

We're proud to announce that Meet me at NooN was selected as one of the winners of the Tencent's Games Without borders Award 2022.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42035039/58507e8b37f940bc7715160ac45b90dead9e26d3.png[/img]

To celebrate this good news, we decided to start a special discount (40% off) from now to the 22nd of December.

notes.title: Quick mode and Ghost | New 1.1 Patch
notes.content:
Welcome back time travelers, we've got some news for you. 

We're happy to announce you our [b]Patch 1.1[/b]. 

This patch will bring two new features and some various bug fixes. 

The new features will be available in the Settings menu and are called [b]Fast movement[/b] and [b]Preview next turn[/b]. This is essentially a quality of life improvement. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42035039/e8e05014bad36671a8429730908d062b03483db6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42035039/276db990652180e8e0f24f2c652aa2151f30b5ea.jpg[/img][/url]

[list]
[*][b]Fast movement[/b] is self-explanatory: this option will speed up a lot of animations and allow you to go through the levels much more quickly. 

[*] [b]Preview next turn[/b] will be activated by default for new users. This option will add a ghost trail of the next recorded move.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42035039/b1eb8361fc2eb65d162956b53bc0fd0c1715da95.gif[/img]
[/list]

If you experience any issues or want to give feedback, please join the official Pandaroo Interactive Discord : https://discord.gg/xNwmsgxk or use the community hub.

Thanks,

[b]The Pandaroo Interactive Team[/b]

notes.title: Discover Meet me at NooN with an exclusive demo
notes.content:
Hello there!

The Cerebral Puzzle Showcase has started and that means you can play Meet me at NooN demo from May 19th to the 23rd!

The Grand Hourglass of time is broken and splitted into two spirits. We need your help to restore the flux of time. Control the two spirits, figure out the new rules of the continuum and solve brain-scratching puzzles.

Please remember to add Meet me at NooN to your wishlist if you enjoyed the game so far!

Have a nice time trying all the amazings games available for the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase

notes.title: Release news
notes.content:
Meet me at Noon started as a 2 months challenge project, but as we progressed in the development, we saw more potential in the game than we expected.

That's why we decided to postpone the release to June in order to add some features to the game we think are essentials to turn Meet Me At Noon into a great game.

In short, we want to add more levels, improve the learning curve and continue to have the game tested for better puzzles

We're sorry for those who were looking forward to play our game this month, but we are sure that this extra time to polish the game will be worth it.
Thank you for your interest and stay tuned for upcoming news about Meet me at NooN.
